privacy: Do not unmask redacted personal details, identify protected residents, store tenant names, or infer unknown beneficial owners from registered agents or shared addresses.

existingDatasets.limits: Dated municipality-level aggregate; not paid leases, a property-level time series, or redistribution rights for raw listings.
Government program benchmarks, not observed local market rental transactions.
Existing public entity relationships are not proof of local parcel ownership or household impacts.

entityKeyStrategy.parcel: state_code + county_fips + municipality + official_local_block_lot_or_parcel_id + official_version; address is not the stable key
entityKeyStrategy.legalEntity: jurisdiction + registration_number when published; preserve original names and dated aliases
entityKeyStrategy.campaignCommittee: FEC committee ID or state filing authority ID and election jurisdiction
entityKeyStrategy.electedOfficial: source official actor ID, office tenure, district-boundary version and vote date
entityKeyStrategy.legalDecision: jurisdiction + issuing authority + docket/bill/ordinance/permit ID + version/effective date
entityKeyStrategy.temporalSemantics: Effective time (real-world interval) is stored separately from observed/retrieved/review time (when we learned it). NULL effective_to means unknown, never verified still active.

highRiskGuards: A shared postal address or registered agent is an administrative association, not equity ownership or control.
Never derive a beneficial owner solely from a recursive company-name similarity chain.
FinCEN BOI access is not an open ownership API; as of August 2026 domestic reporting was exempt.
Record personal executive donations as personal, not as employer corporate treasury spending.
Separate PAC contributions, direct candidate contributions, independent expenditures, lobbying expenditures and in-kind support.
A lobbying report naming multiple topics does not allocate the full reported spend to any one bill.
An FTC/DOJ review that ends without a challenge is not an affirmative FTC approval.
Track local zoning board or municipal council decisions separately from state legislative roll calls.
A housing listing asking rent is not a signed lease rent; eviction filing is not an eviction executed.
Do not assume neighboring jurisdictions form a valid causal control without parallel-trends, spillover and composition checks.
Do not automatically equate ZIP with municipality, tax parcel, school or election district.
Retain official source link, item identifier, release/effective time, retrieval/review times and source reuse status.
Tax lists, property-tax bills, collector receipts, PILOT service charges, tax-abatement awards and municipal budget receipts are not interchangeable.
A tax rate change does not prove any household's actual bill or tenant rent changed.
Owner of record, taxpayer, remitter, escrow servicer, property manager and beneficial owner may be different legal persons.
An approved PILOT is a government policy instrument, not automatically corruption or net revenue loss.

stageGates.needed: Official parcel ID with correct geography and dated tax/assessment vintage; never infer ownership from a street address alone.
Owner on legal source plus separate dated company-control documentation; show unverified intermediate links.
Exact filing amount, payer legal capacity, recipient committee, jurisdiction and dates.
Specific municipal ordinance/zoning decision or state bill, issuing body, recorded vote and effective date.
Actual asking rent vs executed lease carefully separated, consistent units and coverage counts; review source reuse permissions.
Valid comparison and measured uncertainty; descriptive connections alone never become a causal finding.
Official parcel assessment, tax-year rate, final tax bill, collector posted receipt and any PILOT agreement tied to exact parcel; never infer actual payment or tenant rent from rates.

taxReceipts.purpose: Distinguish assessed value, lawful tax charge, actual tax collector receipts, PILOT/abatement benefits and municipal cash receipts.

semantics.meaning: Official assessor taxable value for a year; not deed/title or current market value.
Lawful charge/instalment including adjustments, not evidence of collection.
Collector's actual posted payment/credit/refund, not the owner's identity or profit.
PILOT and abatement agreement, its legal terms and actual service-charge receipts; a subsidy estimate requires a valid counterfactual.
Budget vs actual receipts, segregating municipal, county and school portions.

taxReceipts.privacy: No private payer names, bank details, escrow details, taxpayer account identifiers, or redacted protected-person information.
